Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding: alternate invoice-only payment path for StormLens

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward with the 6-week pilot. Our procurement team has a strict PO process that takes ~6 weeks to approve. For the pilot (low-dollar, time-limited), they can do an invoice-only payment route provided Redwood accepts a short addendum limiting liability and confirming data handling requirements.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can temporarily onboard StormLens on an invoice-only path for the pilot, and what the minimal addendum language needs to include so our legal can sign quickly? We can return a signed addendum via DocuSign today if acceptable.

Attached: SOW_StormLens_Pilot.pdf (PDF, 312KB)

Best,
Olivia Grant
Head of Ops, StormLens
olivia@stormlens.com

---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@stormlens.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: alternate invoice-only payment path for StormLens

Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and for sharing the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can support a temporary invoice-only onboarding path for a time-limited pilot with a signed addendum. A few operational caveats below so finance and legal are aligned: 

- Term: We'll allow invoice-only for the pilot period (we recommend capping at 90 days from the signed addendum).
- PO fallback: If StormLens later requires POs for renewals/scale, we'll need to switch to standard PO flow (we'll notify you 30 days before the pilot end).
- Risk controls: Redwood requires the addendum to confirm (a) no customer data retention beyond agreed pilot data retention window, (b) that StormLens will not re-sell or expose the service beyond pilot participants, and (c) liability cap consistent with our standard pilot terms.
- Billing: Invoices will be issued monthly in arrears to billing@stormlens.com; finance will need a vendor record created in our system with tax and ACH details.

I've looped in Jonas (Finance) and Mina (Legal) to confirm the minimal addendum language and vendor setup steps. If you can sign the addendum today we can create the vendor record and toggle invoice-only routing so your first invoice hits regular processing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Mina to confirm the addendum template language.
2) Olivia to return signed addendum (DocuSign link).
3) Jonas to provision vendor record and confirm invoice routing to A/P.

I'll draft the addendum template and share within a few hours.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Hi all — quick note from Legal: attached is a short addendum we use for pilot invoice-only arrangements. Key items we cannot remove: liability cap (pilot-limited, lower than enterprise), data handling and retention clause, and a clause mandating that pilot terms do not constitute a legacy entitlement for long-term procurement.

Olivia — we can accept StormLens' signature on the attached DocuSign. If you sign, please reply-all with the signed PDF and we'll confirm vendor provisioning.
